generation.prompt:
Create ONE beautifully presented contact sheet of EXACTLY SIX new photorealistic photographic background concepts for the INTERIOR TITLE PAGE of a British vegetable gardening book. The contact sheet is a clean 3-column by 2-row grid, on warm ivory, with six equal portrait photographs (each photograph aspect ratio approximately 185:240). Wide overall contact sheet, maximum available resolution. Small simple labels ONLY in the narrow ivory gutter underneath each photograph, never over the photo: "A · 02", "B · 02", "C · 07", "D · 09", "E · 13", "F · 16", in reading order. No book title, no oval, no other text, no graphic overlay within the photos. This is a thumbnail study of distinct compositions, not finished print masters.

REFERENCE ROLES: inputs 1–5 are the EXACT five camera seeds, respectively source 02 home summer garden, 07 allotment bean-support work, 09 allotment wheelbarrow path, 13 allotment courgette bed wide view, 16 allotment climbing-bean row. Input 6 actual John frontal face; input 7 actual John side profile; input 8 lowered-profile sheet, use actual camera views for anatomy if head tilts; input 9 actual John full body checked overshirt / dark T-shirt / worn blue jeans for body scale and wardrobe. Preserve his unmistakable actual likeness: man about 60 with receding short grey hair, natural high forehead, short neat grey beard, correct distinctive nose and sloping chin, ordinary realistic proportions. Bare head, checked open overshirt, plain muted T-shirt, worn blue jeans, brown work shoes; natural plausible poses. No microphone. John is a BACKGROUND ACTOR in ALL SIX, about 20–30 percent of frame height or partly hidden by foreground crops, never a large foreground portrait.

Faithfully develop the real camera views and landmarks, changing to portrait composition thoughtfully by pulling the viewpoint back if needed rather than tightly zooming in. Keep every garden recognisably based on its own seed; do not combine buildings across the home and allotment sites. Preserve visible paths and bed shapes. Beds should look PRODUCTIVE AND LUSH with mixed established summer crops growing in SOIL: courgettes, lettuces, brassicas, leeks and climbing beans in plausible neighbouring beds. Put extra planting only within beds, keep practical paths clear. Different plant sizes, leaning leaves, imperfect edges, occasional small insect holes and mature lower leaves: real Cornish organic gardens, not immaculate commercial CGI, no identical repeated plants, no piles of harvested vegetables. Soft natural summer daylight, convincing cast shadows, rich but credible green colour, no heavy HDR. Medium-wide garden views with foreground crops, middle beds and background, NOT vegetable close-ups or macro images. Keep the upper part of each portrait relatively quiet for a title later, using softly resolved canopy/hedge/distant garden/sky as naturally present; do not manufacture blank panels or a huge empty sky.

A (from source 02/input1): closest to the loved original. A broad lush patch of large courgette leaves and mixed salads fills lower frame, with tall outdoor tomato vines and real garden backdrop. John small, kneeling/sitting low on the path beyond the vegetables, facing the camera with a relaxed friendly closed-mouth expression, hands resting naturally. Camera-facing actor is intentional and essential; don't turn him away. Keep camera approximately at original height and make a portrait garden-wide scene, not a close portrait.
B (also source 02/input1): an alternative of that SAME home garden scene and camera-facing John, composed slightly wider/lower, more layers of plants leading towards him. Place him in the right middle distance, head around middle of image and small in scale, vegetables and quiet foliage fill the scene. Distinct composition, still recognisably source 02; camera-facing actor essential.
C (source 07/input2): retain the long perspective along the allotment bean row and path, boundary wall and broad growing beds. John stands BOTH FEET FLAT ON THE GROUND on the path in the middle/background; remove the chair completely. He ties a reachable shoulder/chest-height joint or training string while the slender bamboo frame remains taller than him; do not shorten the whole structure or put him on anything. Enrich neighbouring beds with vigorous plausible vegetables, beans beginning to cover the supports. Bamboo continuous slender naturally weathered shafts with believable joined crossings, seven-foot scale, feet in soil, no impossible floating struts. John small, head level/three-quarter matching actual reference, normal arms.
D (source 09/input3): retain the lovely long central grass path and the real curved metal hoop structure on its RIGHT, crops on both sides and original distant plot setting. John walks along the middle/background of the path towards the camera, pushing a normal ONE-front-wheel wheelbarrow with both hands on the two real handles, wheels and feet grounded. A modest load of vegetable trimmings. Enrich the existing beds with varied established crops, keeping path visible and still the compositional lead. Warm late-day light like source, beautiful productive garden and small lively actor.
E (source 13/input4): preserve the WIDE bed-level view across the courgette patch, taller climbing crops behind and neighbouring soil beds. Pull back enough to see a real whole patch, several plants and surrounding planted beds, not a giant single leaf. Add realistic crops to sparse neighbouring beds. John a small background figure on a path beyond the courgettes, checking a bed with a natural level/three-quarter head; wardrobe and identity as supplied. No giant close-up fruit. Strong growth is the subject, within a whole garden.
F (source 16/input5): preserve the distinctive receding bean row and real allotment setting, but frame broadly enough for surrounding beds rather than a close-up vine. Beans more generously developed up the correctly joined canes, mixed vegetables growing in neighbouring beds, visible narrow path. John small and beyond the nearest plants, standing on the path beside the farther bean supports with a natural camera-facing glance. Keep slender canes tall and correctly grounded, realistic untidy foliage. A productive garden setting with depth.

Check each person for exactly two normal arms and legs, realistic hand positions and accurate face shape; especially no overlong arm, distorted knee, square projecting chin or round beard tuft. Preserve small scale and foreground greenery. All six images should feel like real photographs from the same gardening book project while each seed's composition remains individually identifiable.
